title: Deep zoom, natural motion and wardrobe repairs
description: Zoom from the full avatar to eye detail, with refined lighting and more natural pelvis and spine motion. Ming-Mei and Iselda keep their hair aligned; Sarah’s underwear and dresses and Ming-Mei’s dress back receive fitted repairs.
highlights: Pinch or wheel past face close-up in solo and Together. Cmd-Shift-9 frames the face; Cmd-Shift-0 restores the normal view.
Ming-Mei and Iselda’s independent hair roots follow added head turns while keeping authored hair animation.
Corrected pelvis and spine alignment across all five avatars, retaining in-place spins, separate foot movement and stable framing.
Sarah receives body-fitted underwear and localized wardrobe repairs; both dresses include the fitted brief.
Ming-Mei’s fitted dress back stays covered through the checked motions while preserving the original upper lace.
Restrained studio lighting refinements retain the existing light, shadow, texture and rendering budgets.
Protected avatar downloads use the native browser network connection for faster large-file transfers.
